settings.outcome: Ten frames built in a single day.

Twelve senior managers built a complete frame in three hours — then gave it away.
settings.blurb: Senior managers traded a strategy session for saws and bamboo; the finished bike was donated onward.

settings.q: How much does a team build day cost?
settings.a: Priced per team, not per head — tell us your headcount and format and we quote within one working day, with a scoped plan you can forward internally.

settings.q: How many people can take part?
settings.a: From 5 to 50+. Teams of 3–5 build together per frame; larger groups run as parallel build stations. Fewer than five? Join an open build weekend instead.
Your venue, UK-wide — we bring the workshop, tools and materials — or come to our London workshop. Indoor or outdoor both work.
None. Every step is guided by our facilitators, and the tools are hand tools — if your team can measure and saw, they can build.

settings.q: What happens to the bikes afterwards?
settings.a: Your choice: keep them, raffle them internally, or have us donate the builds onward on your behalf — the way one company’s builds went to Upcycle in Brixton.

settings.heading: watch a team build a bike together
settings.body: Real bamboo, real tools, one finished bike — and the option to donate it to a community charity.
